correctness.rationale: Exact Lagrange interpolation-to-companion reduction, symbolic characteristic polynomials and positive-coefficient Schur certificates establish an all-positive-ratio theorem. Reciprocal sextic signs and Descartes' rule establish the sole sharp interval; an exact gcd certifies simple endpoint roots. The included checker regenerates all nonstandard identities and supplementary finite-rational checks; experiments are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Gives a complete, sharp, order-dependent classification of a natural periodic high-contrast step pattern: all fixed ratios work through order four, but order five has an explicit finite reciprocal threshold and an ordinary-versus-strong endpoint distinction. This meaningfully separates local ratio sufficient conditions from exact periodic zero stability.
